read.en: Lumentum rose 3.4% on Oct 21 to $850.70, trading between $827.06 and $878.90. It is above the falling 5-day ($840.3) and rising 200-day ($784.5) averages, but below the falling 100-day ($873.8), 10-day ($923.3) and 30-day ($951.8). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($1,023.37), and RSI is 41.
read.zh: Lumentum 10月21日上涨 3.4%，收于 $850.70，盘中区间 $827.06–878.90。股价位于下行的 5 日（$840.3）和上行的 200 日均线（$784.5）上方，但低于下行的 100 日（$873.8）、10 日（$923.3）和 30 日均线（$951.8）。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$1,023.37），RSI 为 41。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $832 Sep 15 low and the 5-day average, but the day's high faded at the 100-day. Resistance is $874–881 (100-day, day's high, Sep 28 low), then $923 (10-day) and $952 (30-day). Support is $840 (5-day), then $832 and $819 (Sep 3 low). A close above $881 would target $923; a close below $832 would reopen $819–800.
read.zh: 收盘收复 $832 的 9月15日低点及 5 日均线，但盘中高点在 100 日均线处回落。阻力为 $874–881（100 日均线、当日高点、9月28日低点），其次 $923（10 日均线）和 $952（30 日均线）。支撑为 $840（5 日均线），其次 $832 和 $819（9月3日低点）。若收盘站上 $881，下一目标看 $923；若收盘跌破 $832，将重新打开 $819–800。
